title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Member Terms: Down-Payment Reduction for Long-Standing Accounts
content:
## Member loyalty terms: tenure and the down payment

**Term.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, the down-payment rate is reduced for account tenure: for an account open 60 whole months or more the reduction is figured per year, half a point (0.5 percentage points) for each whole year the account has been open; for an account open 36 through 59 whole months it is a flat 2 points; and an account open less than 36 whole months gets no reduction.

Tenure is counted in whole months from the account's opened date to the handling date; whole years are the whole months open divided by 12, with any part year dropped. A point is one percentage point of the down-payment rate, taken off that rate.

### Method by tenure

| Whole months open on the handling date | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 0.5 points for each whole year open |
| 36 through 59 | a flat 2 points |
| fewer than 36 | none |

### Worked cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Whole months open | Whole years | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 35 | 2 | none |
| 36 | 3 | 2 points |
| 59 | 4 | 2 points |
| 60 | 5 | 0.5 times 5, 2.5 points |
| 83 | 6 | 0.5 times 6, 3 points |
| 120 | 10 | 0.5 times 10, 5 points |
